Container.Name: omni-siderolabs
Container.Overview: Unofficial Unraid template for Sidero Labs Omni v1.13.2. Before starting, prepare omni.yaml, TLS certificates, a GPG encryption key, a permanent account UUID, and OIDC authentication. Read the included Omni installation guide. Uses host networking, NET_ADMIN and /dev/net/tun for SideroLink; privileged mode is not needed. Host ports must be free. Existing Omni data requires the upstream migration procedure. Omni is separately licensed by Sidero Labs; review its license and EULA yourself.

Config.Name: Omni persistent data
Config.Description: Dedicated persistent etcd and SQLite data. Do not point at an existing deployment without following upstream migration instructions.

Config.Name: Omni private configuration
Config.Description: Pre-create omni.yaml, omni.asc, tls/fullchain.pem and tls/privkey.pem here. Copy and customize the published example. Keep this directory private.
